marks.gloss_en: רבי אבא בר כהנא אמר מהכא: ״הנה הוא זרה את גרן השערים [הלילה]״
R' Abba bar Kahana's source: 'behold, he winnows barley [tonight] at the threshing floor' (Ruth 3:2)
רבי אבהו אמר מהכא: ״וישכם אברהם בבקר״
R' Abbahu's source: 'and Abraham rose early in the morning and saddled' (Gen 22:3)
ורבנן אמרי מהכא: ״לך נא ראה את שלום אחיך״
the Rabbis' source: 'go now, see the welfare of your brothers' (Gen 37:14)
רב אמר מהכא: ״ויזרח לו השמש״
Rav's source: 'and the sun shone for him' (Gen 32:32)
דכתיב ״עולים ויורדים בו״ -- two ascending and two descending, four where they meet
the tanna: how wide was the ladder? eight thousand parasangs
וכתיב ״וגויתו כתרשיש״, וגמירי דתרשיש תרי אלפי פרסי -- four times two thousand
and of an angel it is written 'his body was like Tarshish' (Dan 10:6), and it is learned [as tradition] that Tarshish is two thousand parasangs
מסייע ליה לרב חננאל אמר רב -- the angel's 'my time to say song has not come until now'
Rav (as first reported): three groups of ministering angels say song every day: one says 'holy', one says 'holy', and one says 'holy is the Lord of hosts'
שנאמר ״שמע ישראל ה׳״ ... כדכתיב ״קדוש קדוש קדוש ה׳ צבאות״
the baraita: Israel mention the Name after two words ('Hear, Israel, the Lord'); the ministering angels mention the Name only after three words ('holy, holy, holy, the Lord of hosts')
שנאמר ״ברן יחד כוכבי בקר״ והדר ״ויריעו כל בני אלהים״
the baraita: the ministering angels do not say song above until Israel say it below
וכי שמש לו לבד זרחה? והלא לכל העולם זרחה! -- asked of Rabban Gamliel and R' Yehoshua in the market of Emmaus
it is written 'and the sun shone for him' (Gen 32:32) -- [read plainly: for him]
שמש הבאה בעבורו זרחה בעבורו (= p_shemesh_habaa_baavuro)
R' Yitzchak: the sun that set [early] for his sake shone [early] for his sake
מיתיבי: the ministering angels mention the Name only after three words -- but in Rav's version the third group says it after one 'kadosh'
the baraita: Israel are dearer before the Holy One than the ministering angels -- Israel say song at every hour, and the angels only once a day
והאיכא ״ברוך״! -- 'blessed is the glory of the Lord' (Ezek 3:12) mentions the Name after fewer than three words
rather [Rav said]: one says 'holy', one says 'holy, holy', and one says 'holy, holy, holy is the Lord of hosts'
the Holy One: this righteous man came to My lodging place, and shall he leave without staying the night?
R' Yitzchak: 'he took of the stones of the place' (Gen 28:11) and 'he took the stone' (Gen 28:18) -- this teaches that all those stones gathered into one place
the tanna: they ascended and gazed at his image above, and descended and gazed at his image below; they sought to endanger him -- at once 'and behold the Lord stood over him' (Gen 28:13)
'the land on which you lie, to you I will give it' (Gen 28:13)
Jacob [to the angel]: are you a thief or a gambler, that you fear the dawn?
